row.notes: Runs when this+0x88 (m_refreshSettings) set: for both vehicle slots (+0x140 +0x1c0/0x1c8) sets device +0x88=1 (FFB_DEBUG notifyRefreshSettings log), writes clamped settings record (+0x5c4..+0x5dc, 0..1, first 0..1.5), pushes trueforce value +0x5f0*24/1.5 to +0x40->+0x90 (LOGITECH log), then clears this+0x88.
